يغرندون (form IIIq)
# يَغْرَنْدُونَ (yaḡrandūna) /jaɣ.ran.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# يُغْرَنْدَوْنَ (yuḡrandawna) /juɣ.ran.daw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
